note: Delta recreation area on Three Mile Slough off Hwy 160 near Rio Vista, with a ten-lane boat launch and swim beaches on Seven Mile Slough. The Willow and Cottonwood loops sit on the slough levee; the Olympic loop by the launch holds the hookup sites and takes no tents. Also walk-in tent sites, a cabin and a group camp. The entrance gate closes one hour after sunset. --Claude
